'''Virtual Set 16''' is a Players Committee virtual expansion from the 2014 Reset onward. It was released 3 September 2021. These are not Decipher cards.

Current virtual cards are maintained by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee. Printable slips are published with each set.

The Cosmic Force: Once per turn, may peek at the top X cards of your Force Pile or Lost Pile, where X = the number of Jedi 'communing'; may move one of those cards to the bottom of that pile.
|}
